svg.title: The Taylor principle: count the eigenvalues
svg.desc: Eigenvalue moduli of the model with the rule, against the unit circle. With phi_pi = 1.5, 2 of 2 are outside (a unique bounded solution); with phi_pi = 0.8, 1 of 2 (many bounded solutions). Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.

g.text: Three-equation New Keynesian model, quarterly, calibration as in Galí (2015), ch. 3. Pure simulation, no data.

text.style: fill: #57606a; font: 9.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research. Woodford (2003); Clarida, Galí and Gertler (1999); Galí (2015).
